Description: Admin console design is deferred; ordinary roles receive appropriate Access Denied shield, but navigation link is displayed if manually navigated to URL.
ReproductionSteps: 1. Navigate to /app/admin directly in browser. 2. Observe Access Denied screen.
Workaround: Admin link is hidden from sidebar when isAdmin is false.

Description: Cloud rate limit kicks in on repetitive fast signups from identical IP address without custom SMTP or Captcha verification.
ReproductionSteps: 1. Rapidly execute multiple signUp calls in automated loop. 2. Receive 429 Rate Limit from cloud.
Workaround: Utilize pre-seeded Alex Chen / Dr. Sarah Connor accounts or configure custom SMTP.
